targets: hourly QPE mm ending at t+1h and t+3h
chronological_splitting: pass cutoff timestamps or do separately
notes: MRMS Pass2 may be quality controlled after event time; targets only, never predictors
rainy_definition: Any valid target cell > 0 mm across either horizon; dry requires all cells valid and zero.
availability_limitation: IEM lacks historical receipt timestamps. Ten-minute reporting latency is an explicit retrospective assumption, not measured receipt. GOES uses S3 LastModified.

events.selection_note: TTN/EWR were dry, but MRMS shows rain elsewhere in the region. Retained as mixed; not counted as a dry period or an additional independent rainy event.
Reclassified after regional MRMS inspection; original station-dry screening did not establish region-wide dryness.

event_definition: Rainy event groups are screened with TTN/EWR hourly rain reports and separated by at least 48 hours between complete history/target windows (including the station lookback). All hours within a group share one event ID. This is an operational event-separation rule, not proof of statistical independence.
study_coverage: Configured verified periods within August-October 2026; not continuous seasonal coverage.
evaluation_limitation: Selected event subset; event count alone does not establish evaluation reliability. No evaluation or held-out-storm performance claimed. No scaler fitted or model trained.
